title: Optimize Console: Rehearsal Cards and Flight-Record Audit for Safe Config Applies
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Deliver a console-first workflow that lets customers preview, rehearse, and safely apply batching/caching and routing recommendations with full forensic traceability.

Scope:
- Rehearsal mode: run a dry-run of suggested config changes against a sampled traffic replay (customer-configurable sample window) to estimate token-cost delta, latency percentile shifts, and fail-open safety signals.
- Rehearsal Cards (UI): compact, actionable cards that summarize the change, expected delta (tokens/$/p95), estimated risk, and recommended guardrail toggles.
- Flight-Record audit trail: immutable snapshot of the diff, runtime metrics observed during rehearsal, commit metadata, and operator notes that can be searched and exported.
- One-click safe-apply: apply with pre-flight checks (rehearsal success threshold, circuit-breaker policy), immediate snapshot, and soft rollback window that enables automatic unwind if regressions detected.

Out of scope for this ticket:
- Large-scale autoscaling policy changes (handled by Dedicated autoscale track)
- New backend kernel changes (ENG will own runtime kernels, this is UI + orchestration)

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- 25% of Optimize recommendations executed through rehearsal cards vs manual edits
- Median time to detect a harmful rollout regression reduced from 3h to 30m via flight-record alerts
- 10% reduction in per-token spend for reused recommendations that adopted rehearsal results

Acceptance criteria:
1) Rehearsal engine runs a deterministic dry-run and returns cost & latency delta for a provided sample window and version pair.
2) Console surfaces a Rehearsal Card for each recommendation with clear CTA: Compare, Rehearse, Apply, Schedule.
3) Flight-Record entries include diffs, rehearsal metrics, operator, timestamp, and link to underlying PR/Policy.
4) Applying via the card creates an audit entry, snapshots prior config, and supports a user-initiated rollback that restores previous config and writes a reversal flight-record.
5) UX copy and affordances reviewed and signed off by Design and Security.

2026-03-10 - Ava M.: Draft PRD posted -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/PM-29876+Rehearsal+Cards+and+Flight-Record. Next: schedule demo with Beta customers (two mid-market customers who opt-in).
release_notes: Introduce Rehearsal Cards (dry-run preview) and Flight-Record audit for Optimize recommendations. Adds audit-first safe-apply flow with soft-rollback window and exportable traces.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: storing full request replays provides highest fidelity for root-cause but increases PII risk and storage. We chose derived metrics with linkable IDs (redacted) to re-request replays under strict governance.
Rollout plan: Beta with opt-in customers for 2 weeks, then gradual enable-by-default for accounts with auditor roles enabled.
Follow-ups: ENG to provide rehearsal API SLA (target 30s for dry_run on 95% of requests) and Storage team to surface retention knobs in Console settings.
